title: "Page not found"
toc: false
include-in-header:
  - text: |
      <meta name="description" content="This page does not exist.">
---

That page does not exist — it may have moved, or the link may be wrong.

**The links below must stay absolute** (a leading `/`). A 404 page is served for
any URL at any depth, so a relative link like `research.html` resolves against
the missing path and breaks. `/research.html` always works.

Note that Quarto rewrites these using the path in `site-url` from `_quarto.yml`.
If `site-url` is wrong, every link on this page is wrong — set it before you
publish, and check this page once the site is live.

- [Home](/index.html)
- [Research](/research.html)
- [Teaching](/teaching.html)
- [Outreach](/outreach.html)
- [Contacts](/contacts.html)
